title: Labour Standards Act
source_id: C.S.Nu., c.L-10 (originating as R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c.L-1, duplicated for Nunavut)
verified_how: Fetched the register's per-Act page, titled 'LABOUR STANDARDS ACT, Official Consolidation of', listed under L in the Current Consolidated Statutes and Regulations. Its legal notice PDF (noticeCSNucL10.pdf) is headed 'Labour Standards Act / C.S.Nu.,c.L-10 / Notice under subsection 65(2) of the Legislation Act' and records changes 'made in the June 13, 2022 consolidation'. The consolidation PDF's cover page prints 'OFFICIAL CONSOLIDATION OF LABOUR STANDARDS ACT / C.S.Nu.,c.L-10 / (Consolidation date: June 13, 2022) / R.S.N.W.T. 1988,c.L-1', then 'AS AMENDED BY NORTHWEST TERRITORIES STATUTES', 'AS AMENDED BY STATUTES ENACTED UNDER SECTION 76.05 OF NUNAVUT ACT' (S.N.W.T. 1998,c.38, in force April 1, 1999) and 'AS AMENDED BY NUNAVUT STATUTES'. In force; not repealed. Currency caveat printed by the register on the Act's own page: 'This consolidation is not up to date. See subsequent amendments: S.Nu. 2022,c.14,s.5 and S.Nu. 2023,c.16,s.111.'
notes: Carried-over NWT statute: the Act in force in Nunavut is the Northwest Territories Labour Standards Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c.L-1, duplicated for Nunavut on division day under the Nunavut Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. 28 (2nd Supp.)), since amended by Nunavut's own Legislature and now consolidated as C.S.Nu., c.L-10. Nunavut kept the older 'Labour Standards' title; the NWT replaced its version with the Employment Standards Act, S.N.W.T. 2007, c.13, in 2008, so the two territories' employment-standards law has diverged. Wage payment and minimum wage. Federally regulated employers in Nunavut are under the Canada Labour Code, R.S.C. 1985, c. L-2.
